cached_summary.text: In Western Uusimaa, 35% of people aged 75 and over start treatment within the 6-week target (n=273), against 54% across the county
The gap is widest among those aged 85 and over, at 30%
About 12% of this group start late because they miss the first visit, losing about 14 days each
Phone reminders cut missed appointments by 43% in one Danish hospital, but even with no missed visits at all this group would reach only 47%
